verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents AI-based semantic extraction through `ai_query` and `ai_extract_rules`. These are presented as the alternative to CSS/XPath `extract_rules`, and the docs recommend them when fields are semantic or the page structure is irregular, so no pre-written selectors are needed. Missing for 10: evidence that the LLM can decide on its own which fields to extract (the docs only show the user describing the information wanted), details on output schema or structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an LLM read a page and decide what structured fields to pull out without pre-written selectors

citations.quote: ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI
Use `extract_rules` for CSS/XPath-based extraction and `ai_query` or `ai_extract_rules` for semantic extraction.
Choose AI extraction when the desired field is semantic or the structure is irregular.
